title: Routing seam ownership map (one writer per field)
description: The machine-readable authority for the routing seam (issue #426, ADR-0015). For every field of the routing contract -- the request fields, the decision fields, and the policy fields -- this map names the single side that produces it. One writer per field, the same rule the paperclip ticket contract applies to a ticket owner. A field with two producers is a second authority and is refused by name; a field with no producer is unowned and is refused by name. The gate scripts/check-routing-seam.sh reads this map together with the two schemas and policy-fields.json and refuses either case. The peer tier-routing package (kushin77/hermes-agents#2) is recorded as a SOURCE, never a producer: a source informs the declared policy, a producer writes a field.

caller.description: The fleet work-issuer: the dispatch loop and the brain that hand a unit of work to the routing authority.

authority.description: This repo's single routing authority: the RoutingPolicy port implementation that produces every decision and owns the declared policy.

peer.decision: policy source we map, not a runtime we couple and not a producer of any contract field

request.task_type.meaning: The kind of work the caller asks to be routed.

request.tier.meaning: The tier the caller requests or floors at.

decision.tier.meaning: The effective tier the authority selected.

decision.model.meaning: The concrete model id the authority selected within the tier.

decision.escalation.meaning: The escalation record: status, ladder and terminal outcome.

policy.fail_safe_route.meaning: The declared route for an undeclared task type.
